The fix exports `gdbm_dir_entry_valid_p` and inserts `gdbm_dir_entry_valid_p (dbf, bucket)` as the first conjunct before any `dbf->dir[bucket]` access. In the vulnerable source, the condition above performs the directory lookup as soon as the hash-equality conjunct succeeds.
